title: An opening of a shelved item
description: What POST /api/v1/shelf/{key}/open answers and `ingestion shelf open --json` prints. The first opening appends the person's read decision with cause shelf-open. For a summary it queues one model read under the shelf's lens. For a relate it queues nothing, and the CLI hands the item to psyche relate on the person's machine. A later opening appends and queues nothing, so it answers the kept summary with no model call. An item that is not on the shelf is refused with 409 not_shelved.

opened.description: Whether this request opened the item, and false where an earlier one had.
